notes.title: Gestalt v1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A patch for Gestalt: Steam and Cinder has been released and includes the following changes and fixes.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a fast forward feature for all cutscenes and dialogues in the game.
[*] Replaced pixel font for a system font for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese to improve readability.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed various Simplified Chinese translation issues.
[*] Fixed an issue so health and healing flasks now correctly resets when respawning or loading at a tether.
[*] Fixed an issue where dropped items could get stuck in the ceiling.
[/list]

Note: You can report any issues or feedback after this patch using our support desk found [url=https://metamorphosisgames.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]here[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/qMepFa9TmP ]community Discord server[/url]. Please include as much detail as you can about the issue to help us better resolve your problems.

Thank you for playing our game!

The Gestalt Development Team

notes.title: Gestalt v1.0.4.1 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
A patch for Gestalt: Steam and Cinder has been released and includes the following changes and fixes.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added option to Disable Screen Shake in video settings.
[*] Healing Flask now replenishes when first entering and when respawning after dying in either of the two monorail rooms.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Saves will now correctly show in the selection menu after crashing. This fixes the "Save Corruption" issue that players had where their saves would no longer show on the selection menu making it seem like their files were deleted.
[*] Added prevention check to not record a enemy's death if the player should've died in the same frame that the player would've killed the enemy.
[*] Fixed Blue Flame Jet's collision size as there was a gap at the top.
[*] Fixed incorrect speaker during the chrome knight intro dialogue.
[*] Fixed issue allowing the player to go back into the monorail sequence that soft-locks the player in the monorail sequence. Players soft-locked in monorails should instantly teleport out to Sylva's crash site and have their monorail questline marked as completed.
[*] Fixed issue that caused Chrome knight to not be re-encounterable if the player died on the same frame they defeated chrome knight.
[*] Fixed issue where Chrome Knight wouldn't play defeat cutscene when clearly being defeated.
[*] Fixed issue where marlowe could remain in vincent's pub after completing scrap sea.
[*] Fixed issue with Aletheia being blocked by invisible collision when trying to enter Meropis.
[*] Fixed various typos and incorrect speaker issues.
[*] Fixed issue to prevent player from being placed on ladder first before moving to loaded save point.
[*] Fixed issue causing destroyed Blue Tesla Coil icons to remain on the map.
[*] Removed invisible damage collision tiles in  scrap sea room 9.
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] You can report any issues or feedback after this patch using our support desk found [url=https://metamorphosisgames.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]here[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/qMepFa9TmP]community Discord server[/url]. Please include as much detail as you can about the issue to help us better resolve the issues you are having.

Thank you for playing our game!

The Gestalt Development Team

notes.title: Gestalt v1.0.1 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
A patch for Gestalt: Steam and Cinder has been released and includes the following changes and fixes.
[list]
[*] Fixed a soft locking issue caused by talking to Eniac before talking to Marlowe in Charon's Hut when returning with Charon's Ring. Simply talking to Marlowe a second time will resolve the issue for players who've encountered this issue in their play through.
[*] Fixed the Bounty Board Durandals' names not being properly localised.
[*] Fixed the ordering of doors on the map for internal rooms
[/list]

This patch is mainly a hot-fix patch to address a soft locking issue players have been experiencing. A few bonus fixes were also thrown into the mix.

We are working on a larger patch to come in the following week to address more minor issues players have experienced.

notes.title: Steam Demo v0.14.11 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
A patch for the Gestalt: Steam and Cinder Demo has been released and includes the following changes:

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Auto Saves now takes priority over the primary save file selection if there's an auto-save available and it's newer than the last Tether Save. (Instead of being an option on the left of the file selection.) This allows players to resume progress from the most recent room if quitting to the main menu or crashing. (Some rooms such as cutscene-specific rooms don't auto-save on purpose.)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed a performance issue with the Renard and Cassandra cutscene.
[*]Fixed camera room trigger size not triggering camera room change in the vent that accesses Fenton's hidden room.
[*]Fixed energy gain graffiti tutorial's art to accurately show bullet slot filled
[*]Fixed interaction prompts on Tesla switches in rooms 1,2 and 3 not properly appearing based on the current state of the tesla switch.
[*]Fixed the layering order for map markers placed by the player.
[*]Fixed a soft-locking bug that locked Aletheia into a crouching state. This occurred when you tried to heavy-attack while crouching without having the charge blade upgrade unlocked.
[*]Fixed a typo in the Ground slam ability's description text.
[*]Fixed a typo for the word "Jotun", in Simon's dialogue after falling from the boiler room.
[*]Fixed a typo in Charge Spin's ability description text.
[*]Fixed a typo of the word "whelp" in Bram's vent conversation.
[/list]

[h2]Balances Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Increased Back Step Blade ability damage multiplier to 275% up from 225%.
[*]Increased enemy damage for the Mini M.E.S.S's shock area of effect attack to 15 up from 10.
[*]Increased enemy damage for Clockwork Mini Enforcer to 15 up from 10.
[*]Increased enemy projectile damage from Clockwork Shocker to 10 up from 5.
[*]Increased enemy projectile damage from Mini M.E.S.S to 10 up from 5.
[/list]

A big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who provide feedback and reported issues for the Demo!

[b]REMINDER![/b] You can report any issues or feedback after this patch [url=https://metamorphosisgames.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]here[/url]. Please include as much detail as you can about the issue to help us better resolve the issues you are having.

[i]The Gestalt Development Team[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
Hello again, 

In response to a few notes on the keyboard controls, we've made a couple of changes to make keyboard users' lives easier.

-- Metamorphosis Games

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We're so happy you seem to be enjoying the demo. We've implemented a few things to make sure that everyone gets the most out of the demo. 

Change log:
- Reload the gun on keyboard with 'O'.
- Additional tutorial text added (don't forget to roll through enemies!).
- Additional poultices added to Tartarus.
- Enemies slightly rebalanced.
- Poultices now respawn for maximum farming ahead of the boss!

We hope this makes the demo that little bit smoother. If you see any quirks in the demo or want to keep a closer eye on development as we head to release, you can join our Discord (https://discord.gg/ADAuC9)! 

Thank you so much for playing. We cannot wait to show you the rest of Canaan later this year!

-- Metamorphosis Games
